inlineSql: SELECT YEAR(A.SCHM_DATE) as YrCode,MONTH(A.SCHM_DATE) AS MnCode FROM AD_DATA AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? GROUP BY YEAR(A.SCHM_DATE),MONTH(A.SCHM_DATE) ORDER BY YEAR(A.SCHM_DATE),MONth(A.SCHM_DATE)

SELECT A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,B.AC_MOBILE,YEAR(A.SCHM_DATE) as YrCode,MONTH(A.SCHM_DATE) AS MnCode,SUM(A.MEMB_AMT) AS MembAmt FROM AD_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AD_MEMB AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? GROUP BY A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,B.AC_MOBILE,YEAR(A.SCHM_DATE),MONTH(A.SCHM_DATE) ORDER BY A.MEMB_CODE,YEAR(A.SCHM_DATE),MONth(A.SCHM_DATE)

Select A.MEMB_CODE FROM AD_OS AS A LEFT JOIN AD_MEMB AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND B.MEMB_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.MEMB_CODE ? HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.OS_TYPE = 'A' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN A.OS_TYPE = 'D' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '-' THEN A.ADJ_AMT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) <= 0 ORDER BY A.MEMB_CODE
SELECT IT_DESIGN FROM ITM_WT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_DESIGN <> 'N'

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME,B.IT_TYPE FROM ITM_WT_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? ' ? ORDER BY IT_CODE,IT_DESIGN,SR_NO

SELECT A.IT_CODE AS Code, SUM(CASE WHEN VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_PCS ELSE -ITM_PCS END) ELSE 0 END) AS ClPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END)ELSE 0 END) AS ClQty,SUM(CASE WHEN VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE - ITM_NWT END) ELSE 0 END) AS ClWt, SUM(CASE WHEN VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END)ELSE 0 END) AS ClGrWt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.ITM_NWT >= ? AND A.ITM_NWT <= ?

SELECT A.IT_CODE AS Code,A.DESIGN_NO As Design, SUM(CASE WHEN VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_PCS ELSE -ITM_PCS END) ELSE 0 END) AS ClPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END)ELSE 0 END) AS ClQty,SUM(CASE WHEN VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE - ITM_NWT END) ELSE 0 END) AS ClWt, SUM(CASE WHEN VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END)ELSE 0 END) AS ClGrWt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.ITM_NWT >= ? AND A.ITM_NWT <= ? AND A.DESIGN_NO = ' ? IT_DESIGN ? '
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
Select * From AD_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND SCHM_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT SCHM_CODE As CodeL,SCHM_NAME as SchemeNameL, SCHM_AMT AS AmountR,SCHM_TYPE As SchmTypeM FROM AD_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY SCHM_CODE
Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT A.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE As ItCodeL FROM ITEM_MAST AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.IT_CODE
Select * From LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? '
Select LC_CODE As CodeL,LC_NAME As NameL,LC_ADD1 As AddressL,LC_CITY As CityL FROM LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY LC_CODE
